title: Bal Hanuman
overview: The film is about the adventurous childhood enthrallments of Lord Hanuman and is full of action, fun, and information. He is shown as the savior of the weak. A major part of the film has action sequences, as Bal Hanuman is known for his Power. The little, cute, mischievous, strong, and brave Bal Hanuman is fighting the demons, who come in different forms of evil creatures to create terror and disturbance on the earth.
